hints: The right-angle condition at $C$ requires $m_{AC} \times m_{BC} = -1$.
walkthrough:
The right-angle condition creates an equation for the unknown vertex.
Write the gradients of $AC$ and $BC$ in terms of $k$:
$$m_{AC} = \dfrac{k - (-2)}{2k - 3} = \dfrac{k + 2}{2k - 3}$$
$$m_{BC} = \dfrac{k - 4}{2k - 11}$$

hints: Obtain the two values of $k$: $k = 1$ and $k = 5$.
Substitute each $k$ into $(2k, k)$ to get the coordinates of $C$: $C(2, 1)$ and $C(10, 5)$.
walkthrough:
The right-angle condition creates an equation for the unknown vertex.
Factorize the quadratic equation:
$$k^2 - 6k + 5 = 0 \implies (k - 1)(k - 5) = 0$$
$$k = 1 \quad \text{or} \quad k = 5$$

Substitute each value of $k$ into $C(2k, k)$:
$$\text{When } k = 1: C = (2(1), 1) = (2, 1)$$
$$\text{When } k = 5: C = (2(5), 5) = (10, 5)$$
